text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan (Barang-Barang

Kawalan) (No. 2) 2026.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 14 Mac 2026 hingga 28 Mac 2026.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging lembu tempatan (kecuali bahagian batang pinang)

2. Daging lembu import

3. Daging kerbau import (India)

4. Tomato

5. Timun

6. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

7. Kacang panjang

8. Sawi hijau

9. Lobak merah (China)

10. Halia tua import

11. Ikan kembung termasuk ikan mabung (berat antara 8 ekor hingga 12 ekor

sekilogram)

12. Ikan selayang (berat antara 8 ekor hingga 12 ekor sekilogram)

13. Ikan aya atau tongkol (berat antara 1 ekor hingga 2 ekor sekilogram)

14. Ikan demuduk, sagai, cermin atau cupak (berat antara 3 ekor hingga 5 ekor

sekilogram)

15. Santan

16. Kacang dal (Australia)

Dibuat 5 Mac 2026

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/JLD.14]

 DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 2) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles) (No. 2)

Order 2026.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 14 March 2026 to 28 March 2026.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local beef (not including tenderloin)

2. Imported beef

3. Imported buffalo meat (India)

4. Tomato

5. Cucumber

6. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including

Beijing cabbage)

7. Long bean

8. Green mustard

9. Carrot (China)

10. Imported old ginger

11. Indian mackerel (weight ranges between 8 fishes to 12 fishes per kilogram)

12. Scad (weight ranges between 8 fishes to 12 fishes per kilogram)

13. Tuna (weight ranges between 1 fish to 2 fishes per kilogram)

14. Malabar trevally (weight ranges between 3 fishes to 5 fishes per kilogram)
